description: Re-run a previous patent search to get fresh results, repeating the inputs that steered it — the company scope, the hint, named products, markets, company sizes and the named standard. Free within 6 months of the original search, 1 search credit after that. Asks first either way: the initial call returns a quote listing the inputs it will repeat and whether it is free, and runs nothing until you call again with confirm: true. To narrow or re-read the results you already have, use claimhit_get_result instead — that is free and does not start a new search.

confirm.description: Set true only after showing the user the quote from the unconfirmed call and getting their agreement. Without it, nothing is run and nothing is charged.

search_id.description: The search ID of the previous search to re-run

widen.description: Drop the original company scope and search the whole market. Default false, which repeats the original scope. Use when the first search was scoped to named companies and found too little.

name: claimhit_rerun_search
title: Re-run patent search
